case.pattern_description: No broader multi-transaction fraud pattern was detected, but the direct cardholder report and prior confirmed case history strongly support unauthorized activity.
case.summary: Case HHG-018 was automatically flagged as fraud with an 85 percent probability. The customer immediately reported the $39.08 transaction as unauthorized, which took precedence over the model score and confirmed the fraudulent activity. Investigation logs show no matching past cases and no linked device profile, pointing to an in-person or unlinked online charge. Consequently, the card was blocked at level one and the case was officially closed as fraud.

No device profile linked to this transaction (in-person or unlinked online txn)
Case written to graph as CASE-HHG-018

case.stop_reason: Customer's own unsolicited fraud report is decisive (Section 6).

sar.reason: No FILE_REPORT criteria met: exposure $39.08 does not exceed the $1,000 R2 threshold; no shared-device link was found (R6); pattern was not classified as undocumented (R9).

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer directly reported this transaction as unauthorized at intake (model-assessed probability was 0.85); the customer's own report takes precedence, and the case was confirmed as fraud.
